evidence: Zenodo states that synthetic_data.zip contains electrical simulation data, generated active tension and deformation, while PINN_results.zip contains all optimization results discussed in the paper.

The exact Stage-1 URL is the ACS publication landing page. Its free Supporting Information is a PDF with POLLU equations/QSSA details and training-result figures, not a downloadable structured dataset.

The challenge provides BSPM ECG data for 352 torso-surface sites, electrode/node locations, selected MRI sections, training/test cases and detailed heart/lung/torso geometry for case 3. Paper 837 uses challenge heart/body geometry for its simulations.
